[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Relan Smiff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was awarded the Herpetology Award of the [[Galactic Science Foundation]] for his discovery of giant [[fanned rawl]]s on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Star%20Wars%20Galaxies:%20Bestiary%20-%20Naboo|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Bestiary &ndash; Naboo}}</ref>
